scan.barcode.purpose: Scan QR codes and barcodes with the camera

barcode.render.purpose: Show a code full screen at maximum brightness so it scans easily

clipboard.purpose: Copy scanned text or a Wi-Fi password when you tap Copy

intents.handoff.purpose: Open links you scanned in your browser, after you confirm each one

links.purpose: Web links found in codes you scan

dataFlows.purpose: Scanned text or a Wi-Fi password, when you tap Copy
A scanned link, after you confirm its address

display.title: =item.kind == 'url' ? item.host : item.kind == 'wifi' ? fn.parseWifi(item.content).ssid : item.kind == 'contact' ? fn.parseVcard(item.content).name : item.content
display.subtitle: =formatDate(item.createdAt, 'yMMMdjm')

kind.compute: =lower(item.content).startsWith('https://') || lower(item.content).startsWith('http://') ? 'url' : item.content.startsWith('WIFI:') ? 'wifi' : upper(item.content).startsWith('BEGIN:VCARD') ? 'contact' : lower(item.content).startsWith('mailto:') || item.content.matches(r'^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$') ? 'email' : lower(item.content).startsWith('tel:') ? 'phone' : item.format in ['ean13', 'ean8', 'upcA', 'upcE'] ? 'product' : 'text'
